purpose: Plan-readiness baseline for the proposed immutable AdmissionGraph/AdmissionState. It compares representation prototypes, not a product implementation.

fixtures.realPath: 96-task acyclic mixed-relation graph; root capacity 8; no standalone graph/state is instantiated.
fixtures.prototype: 256-task deterministic DAG with 16-task layers; root capacity 8.
fixtures.highFanout: one root plus 255 direct dependents; root settles unsatisfied before catalog/validation.
fixtures.branchSearch: a binary-ready selection tree to depth 7; retained DFS/BFS frontier is intentionally kept live for heap observation.

measurement.wall: performance.now() elapsed milliseconds per batch; p50/p95 over measured samples.
measurement.cpu: process.cpuUsage() delta per batch; user/system milliseconds are reported separately.
measurement.allocationProxy: process.memoryUsage().heapUsed delta around each batch without forcing GC. This is a live-heap proxy, not an allocation counter.
measurement.retainedHeap: if Bun.gc is available, force GC before and after retaining live branch arrays, then record heapUsed delta; otherwise mark unavailable. This is process-wide and noisy, not a precise object-retention profiler.
